title: fix(plugin-detail,plugin-gantt,plugin-grid,plugin-form,app-shell): leg A of the write census reads the affordance-to-grant map (objectui#12082)
body:
Part of #12082 (leg A of the write-census backlog; the backlog freeze and leg B stay on the card)

Clause-②: no

`domain:ui` seat 2 dispatch, claim `6106206228`, implementation session `session_01TYgwmFK1q4KJ6Qq2WRLzsD` (subagent mode: the seat's id). The card stays open: this round converts leg A only, per the claim's sequencing call.

## What lands

Ten `unmapped` entries of the write census (`WRITE_SITES` in `packages/plugin-form/src/affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`) become `mapped`, each read where its affordance is offered. **No row is added to `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS`**: every site reuses the row of the same verb on the same object, and the row comments now name the new affordances. So `@object-ui/core` is `patch` (comment-only source change).

| Census entry (site) | Row | Read in | How a closed row withholds it |
|---|---|---|---|
| calendar, kanban, gantt `renderRecordOverlay` update (3) | `recordEdit` | `plugin-detail` `RecordDetailPanel` | no inline-edit session: `canEdit`, `inlineEdit` and the save bar all see no handler |
| gantt `handleTaskUpdateDefault` (bar drag / resize / progress, in-place title) | `rowEdit` | `plugin-gantt` `ObjectGantt` | `onTaskUpdate` withheld from `GanttView` |
| gantt `persistDependencies` (link create / delete) | `rowEdit` | `ObjectGantt` | `onDependencyCreate` / `onDependencyDelete` withheld |
| gantt `confirmDelete` (row Delete) | `rowDelete` | `ObjectGantt` | `onTaskDelete` withheld |
| grid `useBulkExecutor` per-row / undo / retry update (3) | `rowEdit` | `plugin-grid` `ObjectGrid` | a `bulkActionDefs` `update` def is filtered from the bar, as a `delete` def already was on `rowDelete`; no dialog, so no undo or retry |
| `MasterDetailForm` `sendBatch` | `relatedNew` / `relatedRowDelete` on the child (+ the form rows for the header) | `MasterDetailForm` (+ `fieldWriteGate`) | the line grid's `allowAdd` / `allowDelete` |

The riders triage placed with leg A:
- **Line items, `childSchema`:** `LineItemsPanel` hands the child schema it already loads (for the save's sanitize) to `relatedNew` / `relatedRowDelete`, so the child's own policy (`managedBy`, `userActions`) is read, as `RelatedRecordActionsBridge` does.
- **`ExcelImportBar`:** reads `listImport` of the picked object; Import is disabled when the row is closed, and picking another object asks again.

`GanttView.tsx`, `useBulkExecutor.ts`, `resolveBulkActions.ts`, `BulkActionDialog.tsx` and the three overlay hosts are not edited: each affordance is already drawn from handler or def presence, so the gate sits where the handler is handed over.

## Measured on main first

Each runtime pin was written against BASE source and is the defect direction when red. Recorded run (restore-trapped script, commit `9e3748a`): the seven source files checked out at BASE `29b99490` blobs (7/7 hashes equal on disk, each fix anchor counted 0), then the six runtime pins and the census:

`Test Files 7 failed (7)` · `Tests 28 failed | 73 passed (101)`; restore proven: `7/7 blobs == HEAD (9e3748a), git diff HEAD empty`.

| Pin | red on BASE | what was red | stayed green on BASE (controls) |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugin-detail` `RecordDetailPanel.editGrant-12082` | 4 / 9 | create-only and read-only shapes (with an `editable: true` field entry), an operation set without `update`, `userActions.edit: false` | edit-only, full, fail-open, the plain read-only shape (see H6) |
| `plugin-gantt` `ObjectGantt.writeGrant-12082` | 7 / 11 | every shape lacking update or delete, the operation set, the policy | edit-only update, full, fail-open |
| `plugin-grid` `bulkUpdateGrant-12082` | 4 / 7 | create-only, read-only, the operation set, the policy | edit-only, full, fail-open |
| `plugin-form` `MasterDetailForm.lineGrant-12082` | 6 / 11 | edit form: create-only (remove), edit-only, read-only; create form: edit-only, read-only (entry row present); the operation set | full, create-only create form, fail-open, the H4 measurement |
| `plugin-form` `LineItemsPanel.lineGrant-12082` | 1 / 8 | the child-policy rider | the round-1 cases, the rider's control |
| `app-shell` `ExcelImportBar.importGrant-12082` | 4 / 7 | edit-only, read-only, the operation set, the picked-object case | create-only, full, fail-open |
| census `affordanceGrantMap-12082` | 2 / 48 | "every mapped site names rows … read by one of the files it names" (16 problems), the overlay one-seam pin | the rest |

### The PM's hypotheses, as measured

- **H1 holds.** All three hosts reach the overlay's inline edit through `RecordDetailPanel`'s `onFieldSave`, and `recordEdit` is the row the record page reads for the same in-place edit. The grid and tree overlays hand no `onFieldSave` (read-only by design) and are unchanged.
- **H6, overlay, partly already closed.** Since objectui#12117 each field asks the row's field question, so the plain read-only shape (no field entry, `allowEdit: false`) was already withheld on BASE (the CONTROL case is green on BASE). The site still reproduced through the three object-level layers the field question does not ask: a permission set naming a field `editable: true` under an object grant without `allowEdit`, an effective operation set without `update`, and an object policy closing edit. Those are what the `recordEdit` read closes.
- **H2:** the gantt needs no internal prop: `GanttView` already draws every edit affordance (drag, resize, progress, in-place title, link handles, the Delete item, undo, auto-schedule) from handler presence. Reused `rowEdit` / `rowDelete` rather than adding gantt rows (Zone 3: reuse where verb and object match).
- **H3:** the gate sits in `ObjectGrid` where `bulkActionDefs` are resolved, reading the `rowEditVerdict` already computed there. objectui#12119 had landed before this branch's base (`29b99490`), so both intents are in the file. Undo and retry are only reachable from the dialog of a def the bar drew, so they inherit the verdict.
- **H4, measured.** A create form's batch is `buildMasterDetailBatch`: the parent create plus one create per line, never a delete. The MEASURED case adds two lines, removes one, saves, and reads `[sales_order:create, sales_order_line:create]` with the kept line's value. So remove asks `relatedRowDelete` on an edit form only; on a create form it stays open for a create-only caller.
- **H5:** the census keys one site for two mounts, so a new `HOST_GATED` list holds every console mount of `ImportWizard` (a JSX element of that name, found by the same TypeScript walk) to the site's `readBy`, and the existing mapped-site check holds each named file to reading the row. Ablation A1 below.

### Ablation A1 (the mount census can fail)

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) WRAP mode at `9e3748a`, prediction written first: drop `EXCEL_IMPORT_BAR` from the import wizard entry's `readBy` → the mount census alone goes red naming `ExcelImportBar.tsx`. Observed: anchor 1 → 0, blob moved; `Tests 1 failed | 47 passed (48)`, the one failure "packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/ExcelImportBar.tsx mounts ImportWizard but is not named by …"; restored `blob == HEAD (47a5b1510dad)`, `git diff HEAD` empty. As predicted.

## Merge of main

objectui#12089 (the objectui#7611 epic) landed while this round ran; `main` `0df67f23` is merged. It added two `unmapped` Setup entries (`PositionHoldersSection` add / remove, not the three the claim expected); both are kept byte-for-byte, beside the existing leg-B entries. The census on the merged tree: 13 `unmapped` entries left, all leg B (feed 5, Setup 4, dashboard designer 1, related list 3).

A second merge, `main` `10713937`, followed: objectui#12123 also edits `ObjectGrid.tsx` and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-grid.mdx`. It merged clean, and both intents are kept.

## Files beyond the claim's surface

- `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/rowCrudEffectiveOps.test.tsx`: its "drops a bulkActionDefs entry whose operation is delete" case used an `update` def as the control that stays under a read-only operation set; that set now withholds the update def too, so the fixture's set became `['get', 'list', 'update']` (the control still stays, the delete still drops).
- `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/masterDetailDetailsMembers-8071.test.tsx`: it pins the exact key set the block hands the grid. `allowAdd` and `allowDelete`, the map's verdicts, now join it, so the set grows from six keys to eight (`cbbc04e`). The authored `allowAdd: false` still reaches nothing.
- `packages/core/README.md`, `packages/plugin-detail/README.md`, `content/docs/plugins/plugin-form.mdx`, `plugin-gantt.mdx`, `plugin-grid.mdx` (objectui AGENTS.md #2).

## Acceptance notes

Noted, not filed (no measured reach at a public door, or a pre-existing limit):
- The gantt's drag and the grid's bulk update read the row's object verdict only. Neither applies the row's per-record `userActions` predicates (`visibleWhen` / `disabledWhen`), and neither asks the field question of the fields it writes (dates, progress, the dependencies field, the patch keys). The calendar reschedule and the kanban move have the same two limits (round-1 note). An `editable: false` field is still refused only by the server.
- `ExcelImportBar` reads `listImport` with the default bucket (it has not read the target's schema when it offers Import), and its target fields come from its own `normalizeFields`, not `importTargetFields`, so they do not ask the field question the list's Import asks.
- `MasterDetailForm`'s line rows read the child's default bucket: a fully configured entry loads no child schema into render state (the sanitize cache is a ref by design, objectui#1581).
- On an edit form, `allowDelete` is whole-grid, so a caller without the child delete grant cannot remove a just-added, unsaved line either (the same `GridField` limit round 1 noted for `LineItemsPanel`).
- `HOST_GATED` is hand-written: a host-gated write component that is not listed there is not seen by the mount census.
- A `value`-provider gantt that also names an `objectName` asks that object's grant, as the calendar and kanban rows do.
